author: hattrill
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**

MTERF superfamily, mitochondrial/chloroplastic  IPR003690
* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

e.g. UniProtKB:Q7Z6M4 MTERF4

* **Description of issue**
Terms: regulation of DNA-templated transcription (GO:0006355)
double-stranded DNA binding (GO:0003690)

Only some of the mTerf families are DNA binding and regulate transcription. MTERF4 is involved in ribosome assembly.

Think you could add the CC: GO:0043231 intracellular membrane-bounded organelle safely, as not aware of any outside mitochondrion/chloroplast
title: MTERF superfamily, mitochondrial/chloroplastic

author: blazaropinto
body:
Hi Helen,

Thank you for that, I've updated the DNA binding term for [GO:0003676](http://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGo/GTerm?id=GO:0003676) and added GO:0043231. The changes will be available in the next InterPro release.

Best,
Beatriz
